integrity: Explicit naturality proof and complete parameter-uniform traces; finite computations are corroboration, not all-order proof; prior nonequivariant classification is acknowledged rather than claimed anew.
limitations: Finite affine planes of order at least 3; inclusive radius-two unit-edge graph metric only.
Rational translation quotient statement uses finite-field Desarguesian planes.
No equivariant homotopy classification or integral quotient-torsion determination.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Integral collineation homology and translation quotients of affine-plane Rips complexes
